newsitem.title: USA: Southern Indian Ocean cyclone threatens shipping.
newsitem.headline: Southern Indian Ocean cyclone threatens shipping.

text.p: Shipping in the vicinity of Tropical Cyclone Pancho in the southern Indian Ocean will remain under extreme risk for the next 48 hours, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.

The cyclone, with 130 mph winds, is near 12.4s/93.0e, moving west-southwest at 10 mph. Pancho will continue on this track and intensify over the next 24 hours before beginning a slow weakening trend thereafter, WSC said.

Tropical Storm Hannah, with 45 mph winds, is in the southern Philippine Sea near 11n/133e, moving north at five mph. Hannah will weaken as it turns more westward this period, probably dissipating over open water by 24-36 hours. This system will become less of a threat to shipping as it weakens.
